1. (Currently amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, __wherein the first component is a humeral surface component and the second component is a removably attached stem, and wherein the humeral surface component is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.__

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface [[and]] __component__ and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface [[has]] __component has__ a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, __and wherein said humeral surface component is elliptically shaped__.

4. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface [[is spherically or]] __component is elliptically__ shaped.

10. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface.

12. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface __on said humeral surface component__ for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface [[has]] __component has__ a smooth articulating surface.

14. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm, __and wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.__

15. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal, __and wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.__

16. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface, __and wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.__

17. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular, __and wherein said humeral surface component is elliptically shaped.__

18. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has [[a variable length wherein said stem has]] __one of different lengths such that the stem, when selected,__ extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface [[connects]] __component connects__ to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface [[connects]] __component connects__ to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper[[, and a screw]] __.__

27. (Currently amended) A __glenohumeral joint implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint to provide__ transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus [[and an implant]].

28. (Currently amended) The glenohumeral joint of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently amended) A [[repaired humerus bone comprising]] __humerus bone implant comprising__ a modular implant with a humeral surface __component__ and a stem, wherein said stem is __adapted to be__ anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone, __and wherein said humeral surface component is elliptically shaped__.

30. (Currently amended) The repaired humerus bone of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm, __and wherein said stem is linear.__

31. (Currently amended) The repaired humerus bone of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear, __and wherein said humeral surface component is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.__
